title: Document coap_waypoints local_creator capacity contract (>= CREATOR_MAX+1 readable bytes)
description: Found by robustness review pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-wmae (P3, pre-existing). coap_waypoints.c:197 text_valid(config->local_creator, CREATOR_MAX, ...) reads up to CREATOR_MAX+1 bytes via memchr (formerly strnlen) from a caller-supplied const char * (header coap_waypoints.h:52 documents the pointer but not the required readable capacity). Behavior is correct today (memchr stops at the first NUL; byte CREATOR_MAX is touched only when the first CREATOR_MAX bytes are non-NUL, identical envelope to the old strnlen), but the >= CREATOR_MAX+1 readable-bytes contract is implied only. Fix: one doc-comment on the header field/param stating the caller must provide at least CREATOR_MAX+1 readable bytes (or NUL-terminate earlier), matching how the fixed-size fields document their bounds. Pre-existing, no behavior change; do along any waypoints-touching bead (2r8s/wgyl family).
